subject: Private deployment feasibility: checklist, architecture questions, and resourcing asks
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask: scoped checklist and clarifying questions for MediSys private deployment

Team —

Following this morning's call with John at MediSys, they want a short feasibility note from us covering:
- Minimal VPC/networking topology they'd need for a proof-of-concept (2-3 hosts).
- Compliance evidence footprints we can reasonably provide within 30 days (logs, key management, audit trails).
- Rough resourcing delta (FTE and infra) vs hosted.
- Any nonstandard exceptions (e.g., allowed outbound traffic, custom monitoring endpoints).

I've sketched an initial checklist (attached vpc-deploy-checklist.md) — it's deliberately terse to keep the ask concrete for architecture and ops. Can Rishi and Karthik please call out major technical blockers and a ballpark resource estimate by EOD Thursday?

Also cc'ing Alex to coordinate the mutual action plan for the customer and ensure we align on cost/contract signals (deal id MS-2026-0457).

Thanks,
Lauren
Product Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-25T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: scoped checklist and clarifying questions for MediSys private deployment

Thanks Lauren — quick read and initial notes below. I'm keeping this focused on architecture/deployment feasibility rather than pricing.

Top-level constraints we saw on the call:
- Customer requires customer-managed KMS and must restrict egress to their monitoring SaaS.
- They requested a single-tenant VPC with private subnets; no public IPs on inference hosts.
- Expected peak qps for POC: ~80 reqs/min with burst to 200 for short periods.

Potential blockers / decisions needed:
1) KV cache & state: our runtime expects some ephemeral local NVMe and optional NFS for shared KV cache. If they block NFS, we need to plan node-local caching only — which increases memory footprint and model duplication.
2) GPU image registry access: their network must allow access to our image registry or we need to provide preloaded AMIs/OVAs.
3) Observability: customer wants to ship traces to their Datadog account — we will need to allow outbound TLS to Datadog endpoints or set up a relay in their DMZ.

Resourcing estimate (POC, 8 weeks, not including sales/customer success time):
- SRE: 0.3 FTE (setup + hardening)
- Infra eng (runtime x infra integration): 0.6 FTE
- Security reviewer / compliance: 0.2 FTE
- Total inferred SW engineering delta: ~1.1 FTE for the POC window.

Infra delta (host sizing for POC):
- 3x GPU hosts (A100 40GB or equivalent), 2x control-plane instances, ephemeral NVMe on each inference node.

I attached a rough Excel with the infra and people delta (vpc-resourcing-estimate.xlsx).

Happy to discuss trade-offs tomorrow — I can modify the plan to be more conservative (e.g., single model variant, lower concurrency) if we need to reduce infra.

— Rishi
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-26T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: scoped checklist and clarifying questions for MediSys private deployment

Good notes — thanks Rishi. Two quick product/contract questions so we can respond to John: 
1) If we require preloaded AMIs/OVAs to avoid registry egress, how long to produce and test?
2) If we cannot use shared NFS for KV cache, what's the expected unit-cost impact (rough % increase) for early-stage customers?

Marissa — can you draft a short paragraph for the customer that accurately sets expectations on trial timings and what we will/can do vs what will require an enterprise enablement path (longer lead time and separate quote)? If you can attach a short SOC2 evidence packet for initial review (redacted), that'll speed their security team.

I'm going to tentatively schedule a working session Friday 1:30pm PT to align on answers and produce the customer-facing one-pager.

Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, John Doe <john.doe@medisys.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: scoped checklist and clarifying questions for MediSys private deployment

Alex / team — attaching a redacted SOC2 evidence packet (soc2-evidence-ask.pdf) and a one-paragraph trial expectations blurb below.

Trial expectations (for POC):
- Lead time: ~2 weeks to provision infra internally and coordinate image delivery. If customer requires AMI/OVA delivery we add one extra week for image bake + validation.
- Security: we can provide redacted SOC2 artifacts and a minimal audit log export for the POC. Full SOC2 questionnaire completion will follow the enterprise enablement cadence.
- Support and SLAs: POC will run on best-effort support; any SLA guarantees require a dedicated Dedicated/Private contract.

Cost signal: POC infra run-rate is likely to be 3-5x our hosted per-token cost for short POCs due to node duplication and reserved GPU hosts. Exact numbers are in vpc-resourcing-estimate.xlsx.

John — copying you so the timelines are explicit. If you want the AMI route, confirm and we will schedule baking and validation windows.

— Marissa
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: John Doe <john.doe@medisys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: scoped checklist and clarifying questions for MediSys private deployment

Thanks for the clarity and attachments — this is helpful. A couple quick items from our side:
- We prefer AMI delivery (avoid outbound registry access). Please confirm the extra week and an expected validation window.
- For KV cache, we'll accept node-local caching for the POC if you note the additional cost. Please include that explicitly in the one-pager.
- On SOC2 artifacts: send the redacted packet to our security mailbox (sec-requests@medisys.com) and we'll start the review.

Can we keep the working session on Friday; Alex noted 1:30pm PT which works for our team as well.

Best,
John
Head of Platform | MediSys Health
